items.title: 8.4.2 Why is Intellectual Property Important? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of why IP matters (PDF 203).

blocks.text: Intellectual property logon ke khayalat aur takhleeqat bachati hai ta ke woh un se munafa kama sakein. Inaam ki yaqeen dihani logon ko ijad aur takhleeq jari rakhne par aamada karti hai; IP takhleeqi salahiyat aur tarraqi ki madad karti hai. Pakistan mein Intellectual Property Organization (IPO) hai jo IP huqooq darj aur mehfooz karti hai (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Agar ijadat azadi se copy ho sakein to jiddat ka kya hoga?
blocks.explanation: Mojid apni laagat wapas na le sakte, to kam log aur companies naye khayalat par waqt aur paisa lagatein.

items: IP takhleeq karne walon ko inaam deti aur jiddat barhati hai; IPO Pakistan IP darj karti hai.
